source.document: Advanced Robotics Command Language Mobile Robots Reference Guide
source.publisher: Omron Robotics and Safety Technologies, Inc.

notes: Omron publishes ARCL as a PDF reference manual only (no machine-readable spec).
arcl_commands.json is DERIVED from the manual by transcribing each implemented command's syntax and response formats; every entry cites its manual page.

The post-login banner (password prompt, command list, 'End of commands') follows the flow described on manual pages 36-37; the exact banner text appears only in Figure 3-2 (an image), so those literals are marked derived_from_figure.

Enterprise Manager (Fleet) queuing responses additionally documented in I618-E-01 (ARCL Enterprise Manager), edata.omron.com.au/eData/Robotics/I618-E-01.pdf; the queue lifecycle implemented here follows I617-E-02 pages 44-45 and 217-237.
